name: Grit & Gold
detailed_description:
Grit and Gold is a first-person, open-world survival game set against the rugged beauty of Northern California. You’ve inherited a vast, untamed piece of land with endless potential but also countless challenges. Build, farm, and craft as you carve out a life in this unforgiving wilderness. The choices you make will shape the future of your land, as you gather resources, construct your settlement, and defend against natural and human threats.

Your adventure doesn’t end with survival alone. A nearby Gold Rush town beckons with its bustling saloons, shops, and a cast of colorful townsfolk. Explore this town to trade, barter, and accept missions that will aid in your quest to transform your land into a thriving homestead.

In Grit and Gold, every decision matters as you navigate a world teeming with opportunity, danger, and the spirit of adventure. Whether you're building the farm of your dreams, hunting for resources, or battling the elements to defend what’s yours, every moment is a test of your grit—and a chance for gold.
